description: Canonical complexity-based dynamic LLM routing rules synchronized with Edge effort_router.ts

trivial.rationale: Routine operations, retrieval, and simple classification favor speed and minimal cost.

standard.rationale: General-purpose summarization, linting, and moderate context generation balance quality and cost.

complex.rationale: Architecture decisions, code reviews, and multi-signal judgment require strong reasoning.

critical.rationale: Deep synthesis, critical security audits, and irreversible architectural decisions escalate to frontier tier.

ai.assistant.chat.rationale: Daily assistant chat favors latency and low cost.

ai.university.quiz_grade.rationale: Deterministic quiz grading only needs a lightweight model.

memory.search.rationale: BM25 and vector retrieval should stay fast.

memory.rank.rationale: Reranking is capped to a small candidate set.

routine_ops.rationale: Scheduled housekeeping and triage require minimal compute.

classification.rationale: Short label/tag classification stays on lightweight lane.

ai.competitor.monitor.rationale: Monitoring requires short summarization and classification.

ai.video.caption.rationale: Caption generation is structured text with moderate context.

provider.chat_auto.rationale: Automatic provider routing is general purpose chat.

edge_llm.invoke.rationale: Generic EF LLM invoke balances latency and quality by default.

memory.lint.rationale: Memory linting may need semantic judgment.

summarization.rationale: Multi-paragraph summarization balances cost and fidelity.

ai.daily.judgment.rationale: Daily judgment combines multiple personal signals.

architecture_design.rationale: Architecture decisions require careful interface and trade-off review.

code_review.rationale: Code review inspects edge cases, security boundaries, and regressions.

ai.notebooklm.distill.rationale: Axis distillation needs deep synthesis across prior decisions.

deep_reasoning.rationale: High-stakes system design or security root-cause synthesis escalates to Opus.

security_audit.rationale: Privileged boundary and vulnerability auditing warrants top reasoning capability.
